headline: A big first down for Indianapolis
what_happened: D.Jones threw a short pass to J.Downs, who caught it and gained enough yards to earn a first down, giving his team a fresh set of four tries.
who: D.Jones threw the pass to J.Downs, with L.Sneed and N.Bolton defending.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for KC because it keeps the opposing team moving closer to the end zone. The Colts increased their chances of winning by 7 percentage points, making this drive more dangerous.
